FlowWorx / ZTD · Zero Touch Deployment

Deploy and migrate enterprise platforms without starting from scratch.

ZTD is an AI-accelerated framework your delivery teams use to deploy new CRM and workflow platforms, and to migrate customers between them. It reads the source, carries that context through design, build and test, and keeps your experts approving every stage.

Talk to us about a partner licence →See the framework →

Platform programmes are slow, costly and talent-hungry.

Discovery on repeat

Requirements and source-system discovery are manual, and redone at every phase.

Scarce specialists

Certified skills are hard to hire on both the source and target platforms.

Fixed price, manual delivery

Customers want fixed-scope programmes; manual delivery makes the margins fragile.

Built for the SI, not for the platform vendor.

Platform vendors now ship migration tools of their own, each designed to bring customers onto its own platform. Your customers need an honest view of what to move, simplify or retire, and you need one delivery method across every platform you implement.

Vendor migration toolsZTD
DirectionInto the vendor's own platformAny source to any target your practice supports
AssessmentBuilt to make the switch look easyNeutral view of what to move, redesign or retire
Who runs itVendor-hosted experienceYour team, inside your methodology
CoversMigration onlyGreenfield deployments, re-implementations and migrations

One lifecycle, from source to go-live

Each stage carries context into the next, so discovery is never redone and nothing ships without expert sign-off.

StageNameWhat happens
1DiscoverRead the source platform's data model, processes, customisations and integrations.
2MapMap objects, fields and logic to the target; flag what to simplify or retire.
3SpecifyAI-run workshops produce business and functional requirements.
4PlanRequirements become user stories, sprint plans and resource allocations.
5Build and moveGenerate configuration, workflows and code to best practice, and migrate data.
6Test and go liveGenerated test cases, data reconciliation and defect prediction before cutover.
